title: 環境・エネルギー機械
subtitle: Energy and Fluid Machinery
keywords: Energy 2.Fluid-driven machinery 3.Microturbine 4.Environmental conservation technology 5.Contribution to local community
educationalGoal: In this course, students learn about energy conversion and environmental conservation technologies in the field of machinery, especially in the field of fluids. In addition, students will learn various energy machines that use fluids, such as pumps and turbines. Students will study the mechanism, performance, and design principles of these machines.
advice: 1. Use of energy resources 2. Energy conversion technology 3. Fundamentals of fluid machinery 4. Environmental conservation technology 5. Comprehensive exercises and presentations
books: Text books: Books on Energy and Fluid mechanics
requiredKnowledge: Fundamental studies of energy machinery are thermodynamics and fluid dynamics, and it is desirable to take these courses first.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain energy problems in Japan.
Be able to explain energy conversion using turbomachinery.
Be able to understand the principles of pumps and perform performance calculations.
Be able to understand the principles of wind turbines and turbines and perform performance calculations.
Be able to explain environmental conservation technology using multiphase flow.
Be able to actively discuss issues and outcomes about issues in the local community.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Student can explain in detail the energy problems in Japan with specific examples. (2) Student can explain in detail energy conversion using a turbomachine with specific examples. (3) Student can calculate pump performance and design. (4) Student can calculate and design wind turbines and turbines. (5) Student can explain the characteristics of multiphase flow and its principles and application to environmental conservation technologies.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Student can explain energy problems in Japan. (2) Student can explain energy conversion using turbomachinery. (3) Student can understand the principles of pump operation and calculate its performance. (4) Student can understand the principles of wind and other turbines and calculate their performance. (5) Student can explain local environmental protection technologies with examples.

lessons.content: Review the course policy, purpose, and outline, and understand the educational goal and achievement level of this subject. Detailed schedule will be explained in the first lecture.
